facts.text: Compile_IsDeterministic sets Needs to alpha and missing thing, then asserts the second serialized Compile output equals the first.
CandidateSet_ExcludesSupersededAndRetracted asserts the emitted fact set equals ids 0, 3 and 4, so superseded and retracted facts are excluded while contested and stale stay.
CandidateSet_ExcludesDossierKind sets one fact's kind to dossier and asserts Compile emits only the remaining normal fact.
Descendants_IncludesChildFactsToDepth3 builds levels 1 through 4 under Root and asserts the emitted set is the first 4 fact ids, excluding factIds[4].
Ranking_ConfidenceAndCentralityOrderFacts gives ids[2] two inbound refs so centrality lifts it above the confidence 1.0 fact, ordering ids[2], ids[1], ids[0].
RecencyWeight_ZeroRemovesRecencyEffect ranks the older fact first with Recency 0 and the newer fact first with Recency 1.
Dedupe_ClustersAtJaccardThresholdAndKeepsCites makes ids[0] collapse into ids[1] at Jaccard 17/20 and keeps ids[2] separate at 17/23.
Dedupe_ClustersAtJaccardThresholdAndKeepsCites asserts two identical short facts stay separate because facts under 4 tokens are never clustered.
at: dossier.Facts.Count(f => f.Text is "one two three" or "three two one")

facts.text: Compile_CompleteModeDoesNotClusterNearDuplicates omits BudgetMode with Budget 1_000_000 and gets budget mode complete with 3 facts and 0 dropped.
Compile_StrictModeStillClustersNearDuplicates with BudgetMode strict keeps a single fact whose Cites count is greater than 1.
Compile_CompleteModeHeaderReportsNoHoldingBack reads the single Facts shown line from a published subjects index.md and asserts it does not contain the word of.
Budget_DropsOverflowAndRecordsIds derives a tight budget from 2 facts' tokens and asserts ids[0] and ids[1] are emitted with ids[2] recorded in Dropped.
Conflicts_ExemptFromBudgetAndExceedSlice compiles at budget 20 and asserts 4 conflicts with 0 facts while UsedTokens exceeds BudgetTokens.
Gap_EmittedForUnmetNeed asks for the need deployment pipeline and asserts one gap with reason no fact.
Need_CoveredByTokensInTextOrTags leaves only backend as a gap because Renders the CHARTS matches text and frontend matches a tag.
IndexDepth_Under300Tokens compiles 20 long facts and asserts summed index fact tokens stay at or below 300 with at most 8 facts.
Packing_SkipsOversizedCandidateAndEmitsLaterSmallerOnes drops the oversized ids[0] and still emits ids[1] and ids[2] within the tight slice.
Packing_StopsWhenRemainingBudgetCannotFitSmallestCandidate ranks 5 equal-confidence facts, emits the first 2 and asserts 3 are dropped.
Packing_DroppedHasNoDuplicatesAndIsRankOrdered asserts Dropped has no ordinal duplicates and appears in rank order.
Conflict_FromSamePathDifferentValues asserts the single conflict field is cfg.port and its Resolution is null.
Budget_IsMeasuredInRenderedForm compiles the same 1200 budget as json and markdown and asserts markdown emits more facts at lower UsedTokens.
Markdown_StaysWithinBudget keeps fact tokens at or below 0.75 of the 200 budget and asserts UsedTokens within 200.
IndexDepth_UsesRenderedCost compiles with Format markdown and asserts both the rendered markdown estimate and EstimateRenderedTokens are at most 300.
Index_EmitsFactsEvenWhenConflictsFillTheEnvelope asserts 3 conflicts and at least 3 facts even when the index conflicts fill the envelope.
Index_JsonAndMarkdownBothReturnFacts asserts markdown index facts count is at least the json count and both are greater than 0.
Index_HardCapOfEightStillHolds posts 20 facts and asserts both json and markdown emit exactly 8 facts within 300 index tokens.
SeqOrder_IsChronological sets Order to seq and expects created_at minutes 10, 20, 30 to win over confidence.
UncitedClaims_IsZero asserts every emitted fact Cites starts with its own id and SelfCheck.UncitedClaims is 0.
Markdown_ContainsEveryFactId asserts the markdown starts with the Widget heading, contains every fact id in brackets, and has Conflicts and Gaps sections.
Relevance_Bm25RanksMatchingNeedFirst makes the need-matching fact the oldest and asserts the deployment pipeline need moves it to position 1.
Relevance_AbsentWhenNoRelevance with empty Needs and equal confidence 0.5 asserts newest-first order, then with Recency 0 the order follows fact text.
Descendants_CycleInParentsDoesNotHang closes an A to B to A parent cycle and asserts Compile finishes under 5 seconds with 2 facts.
Reproducible_SelectionAcrossIndependentStores builds two stores with opposite insertion order and asserts equal fact texts, dropped texts and UsedTokens though fact ids differ.
Reproducible_RepeatedCompileIsByteIdentical serializes 3 Compile runs and asserts runs[1] and runs[2] both equal runs[0].
Reproducible_WithRecencyDisabled_IgnoresWallClock offsets store B's clock by 360 minutes and asserts equal fact and dropped text with Recency 0.
Recency_DefaultStillAffectsOrdering asserts the newer zulu fact ranks first by default and the older alpha fact first when Recency is 0.
Budget_IsBoundedAsCorpusGrows compiles corpora of 50, 200 and 1000 facts at budget 1200 markdown and asserts UsedTokens stays within 1200.
Compile_CompleteModeEmitsEveryFact leaves BudgetMode unset so 200 facts are emitted as complete with 0 dropped and UsedTokens above 300.
Compile_StrictModeStillDrops with BudgetMode strict asserts fewer than 200 facts, some dropped, and facts plus dropped equal 200.
Compile_CompleteMarkdownHasHighlightsThenAllFacts asserts the All facts heading follows Highlights and each posted fact id appears exactly 1 time.
Compile_CompleteMarkdownWithinBudgetIsOneFactsList compiles one fact with no budget and asserts neither the Highlights nor the All facts heading appears.
Compile_CompleteModeIsStillDeterministic concatenates rendered markdown with the serialized dossier from two compiles and asserts they match.
Compile_InvalidBudgetModeRejected expects a DossierRequestException whose message contains complete and strict for BudgetMode bogus.
at: var ex = Assert.Throws<DossierRequestException>(() => db.Store.Compile(new CompileRequest { Subject = "Widget", BudgetMode = "bogus" }));

facts.text: The Exec helper opens a store connection, executes the SQL with named parameters, then calls SqliteConnection.ClearPool.
SetCreated writes an At-formatted timestamp into the facts created_at column for one id.
at: Exec(db, "UPDATE facts SET created_at = $c WHERE id = $id", ("$c", At(minutes)), ("$id", id));

facts.text: Full builds a CompileRequest for subject Widget with Depth full and BudgetMode strict, plus an optional budget.
at: new() { Subject = subject, Depth = "full", Budget = budget, BudgetMode = "strict" };

facts.text: The Post helper calls PostFacts with Fixtures.Post and returns the posted fact ids.
NearDuplicateCorpus builds three facts sharing 20 tokens so each pair has Jaccard about 0.91.
at: <summary>Three facts with pairwise Jaccard 20/22 (~0.91), above the 0.85 cluster threshold.</summary>

facts.text: LogicalFact gives facts below HubCount a local h id and attaches a ref only when the index is at or above HubCount and not divisible by 3.
BuildLogicalStore posts 40 logical facts in the given order, then sets every created_at to At(0) so recency is equal.
BuildStaggeredLogicalStore gives logical fact i created_at At(offsetMinutes + i) after posting the facts in the given order.
TextOf returns the Fact.Text of one id through db.Store.Show.
at: private static string TextOf(TempDb db, string id) => db.Store.Show(id)!.Fact.Text ?? string.Empty;

facts.text: ReproRequest compiles Widget at strict budget mode with full depth and json format, and Needs aspect7 and detail12.
LogicalFactCount is declared as 40 and HubCount as 10 for the reproducibility helpers.
Corpus200 creates 200 facts whose text carries D4 zero-padded index tokens.
The At helper builds a DateTimeOffset at 2026 with all time parts 0 and a zero offset, adds the given minutes, and formats it with the O specifier.
at: private static string At(int minutes) => new DateTimeOffset(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero).AddMinutes(minutes).ToString("O");
